run_f_gold: run f_gold to count balanced binary trees of a given height h modulo 1000000007
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses dynamic programming to count balanced binary trees of height h
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness of its DP recurrence relation for balanced binary tree counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more memory-efficient approach instead of a full DP array
